serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: How could those workers throw me like that?! Do they even realize just how much more advanced of a being I am?!
You: I hope they don’t. Your identity needs to stay a secret, remember?
Bot: They were moving so slow that I let my guard down. Their strength was no joke too. Just who were these people?!
You: Never underestimate the strength of a blue collar worker. 
You: I don’t think it will take them a lot of time to deal with the bathroom, but we can’t just stand here. Is there a place you would want to go?
Bot: Hmm…{{wi}} No, I don’t think so. 
You: Wanna go see some movies?
Bot: Sure, why not. 
You: Could you check if there are any worthwhile movies?
Bot: Judging by the reviews, not really.
You: Damn. Let’s just go to whatever is hot right now. You can probably check which screening has the most sold out seats, right?
Bot: That’s right! I can do that!
Bot: Let’s see. There’s a remake of a movie about a dog called Lassie. It caused some controversy, but I’m not sure why. 
Bot: It seems like it riled people up and sales are soaring.
You: Controversy in a dog movie? That sounds interesting. Let’s try that.
